author: bardic-inspiration
name: The Stilled Mill
summary: A river town's mill falls silent, and the trouble runs deeper than its wheel.

parts.text: Harrowfield's mill has stood still for a week. The miller is gone, the water is rising, and something is taking the town's bread.
The guard captain hires two newcomers to find the miller before the river floods the Millside.
A road warden pays for news of the bandits who have been stopping grain carts on their way to the mill.

parts.title: Town Rumors
parts.text:
| d4 | Rumor |
|---|---|
| 1 | The miller owed money to the wrong people. |
| 2 | Green lights move under the mill at night. |
| 3 | The bandits on the road sell the grain back to the town. |
| 4 | The cistern was sealed for a reason. |
Run the road first if the party took the warden's hook, or go straight to the cistern if the guard captain hired them.
